title: First-person tools: round 5 variations
desc: 15 new first-person takes from J's 852 ratings: 3 each for the no-note IMPROVEs P1b2, S2b3, S2c2, S3c1 (every pick strikes at the crosshair, J's new rule), and S3a3's sweep-pair-with-overhead-loop on three other construct weapons (axe, maul, glaive). Swords heavy and slow with a short charge, no faster than S2c1; mobs react on contact.

takes.name: Pickaxe: side-on strike from the right, two-stage wrench out
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; the spike tip strikes the block at the crosshair; the block jolts and chips fly; hit tick 11; swing 23 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; forms: guide beam, then grows grip to tip behind a bright edge with sparks (as P1b2) (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Pickaxe: side-on strike from the left, twist the other way, lever up
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; the spike tip strikes the block at the crosshair; the block jolts and chips fly; hit tick 10; swing 20 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; forms: guide beam, then grows tip back to the fist behind the bright edge (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Pickaxe: low flat side swing, the head rolls up to twist out
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; the spike tip strikes the block at the crosshair; the block jolts and chips fly; hit tick 10; swing 20 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; forms: guide beam, the bright edge jumps out in three steps with a spark burst each (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Sword: reverse diagonal, roll flat low right, charge, heavy flat return with a step
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; step in on the return; hits ticks 11, 21; swing 29 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 4-8, 16-19); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: ratchets out in four clicks (as S2b3) (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Sword: reverse diagonal, wrap up over the right shoulder, charge, chest-high flat return
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; hits ticks 9, 23; swing 31 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 4-7, 16-19); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: two heavy clicks, a rim flash on each (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Sword: long charge, reverse diagonal bites and holds, low flat return with a deep step
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; deep step on the return; hits ticks 13, 23; swing 31 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 4-10); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: ratchets out tip first (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Sword: X at the S2c1 pace, a different charge per cut, blade rolls flat between, reaches in
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; hits ticks 9, 21; swing 29 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 4-6, 15-19); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: sections unfold out of the grip (as S2c2) (ticks 0-14)

takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; step in and back out on the second cut; hits ticks 10, 20; swing 28 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 4-7, 17-18); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: sections unfold in pairs from beside the haft (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Sword: mirrored X, a flick turn low, longer charge, step into a heavier second cut
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; step into the second cut; hits ticks 9, 23; swing 31 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 4-7, 15-21); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: sections telescope out of each other (ticks 0-14)

takes.name: Sword: three alternating flat sweeps, the third after a long charge with a step
takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; step on the third sweep; hits ticks 7, 17, 32; swing 40 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 3-5, 11-14, 23-29); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: sections fly in and lock (as S3c1) (ticks 0-14)

takes.facts: first person at 120 deg with a crosshair, ring on the punching face; step on the third sweep; hits ticks 8, 19, 35; swing 43 ticks, played twice with a 6-tick rest; charge before the cut (ticks 3-5, 15-16, 26-32); the mob is knocked back and tilts on contact, heaviest on the last hit; forms: sections stream in from beyond the tip (ticks 0-14)
